scope: Host-only bounded synthetic finite-state experiment; no container, GUI, model, GPU, CUDA, or external effects.
limits: This is an exhaustive check only over the preregistered finite command set and initial state.
It does not prove general I-confluence or justify coordination-free runtime execution.
Authority revocation is modeled as a tombstone-wins set; other revocation semantics are outside scope.
External effect dispatch is represented by an at-most-once semantic-ID invariant, not an actual backend.
